name: koa-xhock-site
description: Sitio XHOCK by KOA: Eleventy + Pages CMS + Cloudflare Pages

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && node functions/test/e2e-local.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply koa-xhock --local -c wrangler.dev.toml
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev _site --d1 DB=koa-xhock
